name: Social Contact Block
description: A highly configurable block that displays contact details and social/media links anywhere on the site.
project_description:
Social Contact Info is a powerful and flexible Drupal module that allows you to display professional contact details and social media links anywhere on your website using a fully configurable block system.

 Designed for business websites, corporate portals, agencies, educational institutions, and community platforms, the module helps site administrators easily manage contact information and social profiles with a clean and user-friendly interface.

 Features 
 
 Display contact information and social media links anywhere on your Drupal website using a configurable block 
 Manage address, email, phone, mobile, fax, and business working hours with flexible field controls 
 Add Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Telegram, and WhatsApp profile links 
 Create custom section titles, field labels, and reorder fields easily with drag-and-drop functionality 
 Custom SVG icons, and custom CSS classes for complete design flexibility 
 Built-in validation for email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, and secure SVG sanitization for safer data handling 
 Responsive, AJAX-powered, and theme-friendly architecture with Google Maps iframe support and semantic HTML output 
 
 Flexible Social Icon Support 
 The module allows you to customize social media icons using:

 
 Custom CSS classes 
 Custom SVG markup 
 Text-only social links 
 
 This gives developers and site builders complete design flexibility without modifying templates.

 Easy Customization 
 Social Contact Info is designed for easy customization and seamless integration with any Drupal theme. Whether you are building a business website, corporate portal, agency site, or organization directory, the module helps you quickly create a clean and modern contact section.

 For installation and configuration details, please refer to the README.md file included with the module.
